title: ReadyPath: Family Safety Plan
short_description: Family emergency plan, evacuation routes and a 72-hour kit manager.
full_description:
When natural disasters strike, cell networks fail and navigation apps lead drivers into impassable bottlenecks. ReadyPath is your family's offline-first evacuation and emergency readiness companion.

Pre-plan your family's evacuation routes along verified high-ground corridors, avoid low-water crossings prone to flash flooding, and manage your household 72-hour emergency supplies.

KEY READINESS TOOLS:
• PRE-PLANNED EVACUATION CORRIDORS: Save primary and secondary safe highway routes avoiding bottlenecks and flood-prone low water crossings.
• 72-HOUR EMERGENCY SUPPLY KIT: Comprehensive checklists for water, rations, communications, tools, and emergency supplies.
• OFFLINE DISASTER GUIDES: Step-by-step guides for wildfires, flash floods, hurricanes, tornadoes, and winter grid freezes.
• 100% OFFLINE CAPABILITY: Operates completely without cellular networks, power grids, or remote servers.

Protect your family when every second counts with ReadyPath!
